headline: PHP fixes two critical vulnerabilities after coordinated AI-assisted discovery
summary: PHP released security fixes on Oct 21, 2026 for two critical runtime vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, which its advisory says can enable unauthenticated remote code execution under affected conditions. The PHP Foundation describes a months-long path from earlier audit findings to Calif and OpenAI reports in August, followed by coordinated fixes across supported branches. Cloudflare says it deployed WAF protections before disclosure and saw attack traffic against its customers. The primary sources support the vulnerabilities, fixes and reported coordination; discovery attribution and provider observations remain source-attributed, and this case does not measure global exploitation or establish a general AI discovery rate.
